# Yusuf İhsan Görgel

> Yusuf İhsan Görgel is a software engineer building cross-platform products with Flutter, Dart, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, and production infrastructure.

## Selected Work
- [FugaSoft](https://fugasoft.com/): The ERP and point-of-sale product family I continue to build at Uzman Adres for retail teams working across tablets and desktop operating systems.
- [Dorse](https://dorseapp.com/): A public logistics platform connecting drivers, fleet companies, and weighbridge businesses through mobile and web workflows.

## Packages
- [redis_task_queue](https://pub.dev/packages/redis_task_queue): Redis-backed task queue: retries, a dead-letter list, weighted queues and crash-safe at-least-once delivery. (v1.1.4)
- [re2](https://pub.dev/packages/re2): Linear-time regular expressions via Google's RE2 over FFI — immune to catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS). (v1.1.6)
- [xlsxwriter](https://pub.dev/packages/xlsxwriter): Native .xlsx writer with a constant-memory mode: one row in RAM whether the sheet has 10k or 1M rows. (v1.4.1)
- [mcp_probe](https://pub.dev/packages/mcp_probe): Conformance checks and a test harness for MCP servers: runs any stdio server and asserts on its behaviour from package:test. (v0.10.3)
- [hf_tokenizers](https://pub.dev/packages/hf_tokenizers): The HuggingFace Rust tokenizers crate over FFI: load any tokenizer.json and get byte-exact encoding with UTF-8 offsets. (v1.2.1)
- [simdjson_dart](https://pub.dev/packages/simdjson_dart): Read a few fields out of a large JSON payload without decoding the rest; whole-document and NDJSON decoding too. (v1.6.0)
- [vector_kit](https://pub.dev/packages/vector_kit): SIMD vector maths for embeddings: dot, cosine, normalisation and top-k search over packed matrices. (v1.4.0)
- [instructor_dart](https://pub.dev/packages/instructor_dart): Typed, validated structured output from LLMs with repair retries — plain-Dart schemas, no codegen, adapters for the major hosted providers. (v1.4.1)
- [rag_kit](https://pub.dev/packages/rag_kit): Pure-Dart RAG kernel: chunking, embeddings, vector search and context building — zero dependencies, bring your own model. (v1.3.0)
- [image_ffi](https://pub.dev/packages/image_ffi): Native image decode, resize, thumbnail and JPEG/PNG encode — several times quicker than the pure-Dart path. (v1.2.5)
- [blake3_ffi](https://pub.dev/packages/blake3_ffi): BLAKE3 hashing over FFI: one-shot, streaming, keyed MAC, KDF and XOF — drops into package:crypto's Hash interface. (v1.2.4)
- [audio_decode](https://pub.dev/packages/audio_decode): Decode MP3, Ogg Vorbis and WAV to raw PCM over FFI — a decoder, not a player; runs under plain dart run. (v1.3.4)
- [resilience](https://pub.dev/packages/resilience): Circuit breaker, bulkhead, retry with backoff, timeout, rate limiter and hedge — one Policy interface, zero dependencies. (v1.1.3)
- [llm_eval](https://pub.dev/packages/llm_eval): LLM evals as unit tests: assertion checks, an optional judge, and cached responses so CI stays deterministic and free to rerun. (v1.3.2)
- [stream_struct](https://pub.dev/packages/stream_struct): Stream an LLM's structured output as it arrives: tolerant partial JSON fills a typed object token by token, SSE framing included. (v1.4.1)
- [flutter_prerender](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_prerender): Prerenders a built Flutter web app to crawlable HTML: loads each route in headless Chrome and emits headings, links, meta and a sitemap. (v1.5.0)
- [photo_zoom](https://pub.dev/packages/photo_zoom): Pan, zoom, rotate and swipe a photo gallery — double tap and pinch zoom where you touch, mouse wheel on desktop. (v1.2.3)
- [skeleton_shimmer](https://pub.dev/packages/skeleton_shimmer): Shimmer and skeleton loaders where one sweep is shared across every placeholder — drop-in compatible, reduced-motion aware. (v1.2.2)
- [find_in_page](https://pub.dev/packages/find_in_page): An in-app find bar: wrap your page and Ctrl+F highlights and scrolls to every match — even in lazy-list rows that were never built. (v2.3.2)
- [text_autosize](https://pub.dev/packages/text_autosize): Auto-size text that fits width, height and maxLines — drop-in compatible with the incumbent, TextScaler-aware including nonlinear scaling. (v1.3.1)
- [constellation_particles](https://pub.dev/packages/constellation_particles): Pointer-reactive constellation background that honours reduced motion and high contrast, and pauses when backgrounded. (v1.1.0)
- [expandable_plus](https://pub.dev/packages/expandable_plus): Expandable panels that cross-fade two genuinely different views, with accordion groups and correct screen-reader semantics. (v1.2.5)
- [go_channels](https://pub.dev/packages/go_channels): Go-style concurrency: typed channels, a select that truly withdraws the losing branch, and structured scopes with cancellation. (v1.1.1)
